questions.question: Compare distributive law in sets with distributive law in arithmetic.
questions.solution_html:
• Compare distributive law in sets with distributive law in arithmetic.
  •  Set theory: 𝐴 ∩ (𝐵 ∪ 𝐶) = (𝐴 ∩ 𝐵) ∪ (𝐴 ∩ 𝐶) (1 mark)
  • Arithmetic: 𝑎 × (𝑏 + 𝑐) = 𝑎 × 𝑏 + 𝑎 × 𝑐
  • Comparison: Both show how one operation distributes over another. (1 mark)
